title: Designer
description:
Senior Freelance Designer (Contract)

Location: USA / Canada / LATAM

Type: Contract / Freelance

Experience: 8–15 years


About the Role

Our client is a forward-thinking NYC-based design agency working with a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple industries. They are looking to collaborate with a Senior Freelance Designer to support ongoing client projects, primarily focused on web, visual, and digital design .


This role is ideal for a senior, hands-on designer who is comfortable working in client-facing, agency-style environments , managing multiple projects, and delivering high-quality design solutions from concept to execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and other designers, to deliver effective design solutions aligned with client goals.
  • Lead visual and web design efforts across websites, landing pages, microsites, and digital brand assets.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes using tools such as Figma or Sketch.
  • Develop and maintain visual systems, style guides, and brand consistency across digital and print materials.
  • Design marketing assets including presentations, social media visuals, email assets, and campaign materials.
  • Ensure designs are optimized for both desktop and mobile experiences, following UI/UX best practices.
  • Participate in client reviews and presentations, clearly communicating design concepts and rationale.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure accurate design handoff and implementation.


Required Qualifications

  • 8–15 years of professional experience in Web Design, Visual Design, and/or Graphic Design .
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of digital, web, and visual design projects (portfolio required).
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles , responsive design, and usability best practices.
  • Experience working in agency or client-facing environments .
  • Ability to work independently as a freelancer or contractor, managing priorities and timelines effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort presenting work to clients and stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based clients or international teams.
  • Background in branding and design systems.
  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior designers.
  • Familiarity with motion, interaction design, or basic front-end concepts (HTML/CSS) is a plus.


Engagement Details

  • Contract / Freelance role
  • Flexible hours, based on project needs
  • Fully remote
  • Hourly compensation, based on experience and availability

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)


Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.


Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)


Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.


Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.


Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments.   • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos / Human Resources Analyst
description:
G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais ao setor de mineração, atuando em projetos subterrâneos e a céu aberto com metais preciosos, básicos e industriais. Reconhecida como uma das principais consultorias em engenharia de minas do Canadá e entre as mais renomadas em projetos internacionais, a G Mining está expandindo e consolidando sua presença no Brasil. Após o sucesso do projeto da Mina de Tocantinzinho, a empresa está abrindo um novo escritório no país para colaborar com talentos locais em futuros projetos no Brasil e no exterior.

Como empresa familiar, a G Mining valoriza seus colaboradores, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal por meio de oportunidades únicas de carreira, incentivo à colaboração e um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, seguro e inclusivo.


Analista de Recursos Humanos


Resumo da Posição


O(a) profissional atuará como Analista de Recursos Humanos , apoiando a operação local e contribuindo para a consolidação da estrutura organizacional da empresa no Brasil. Será responsável por garantir a execução eficiente das rotinas de RH e por fortalecer a cultura corporativa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ético e alinhado aos valores globais da G Mining Services.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar todo o ciclo de recrutamento e seleção, desde a divulgação das vagas até o onboarding.
  • Manter e atualizar registros e contratos de colaboradores (CLT e prestadores de serviço).
  • Apoiar nas rotinas de folha de pagamento, controle de ponto, férias, benefícios e rescisões.
  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (saúde, odontológico, alimentação, transporte e seguro de vida), incluindo controles mensais, inclusões e exclusões.
  • Apoiar nas relações trabalhistas e garantir conformidade com a legislação brasileira (CLT).
  • Apoiar na organização e execução de ações de integração, treinamentos e iniciativas de engajamento.
  • Contribuir com ideias e auxiliar na implementação de programas de bem-estar e cultura que fortaleçam a experiência do colaborador.
  • Preparar relatórios e indicadores de RH (headcount, benefícios, custos de pessoal etc.) para suporte à gestão.
  • Colaborar com as equipes globais de RH e Administração, mantendo uma comunicação eficaz em inglês.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas generalistas de RH.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e práticas administrativas de RH.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado, para comunicação frequente com equipes internacionais.
  • Boa habilidade com Excel e ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

Perfil desejado

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e atitude colaborativa.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Empatia, integridade e genuíno interesse por pessoas.
  • Flexibilidade e perfil “mão na massa”.


Informações Adicionais

A posição será baseada no escritório da G Mining Services em Belo Horizonte, Brasil. A empresa busca profissionais dinâmicos e motivados que desejam integrar uma equipe experiente e comprometida com o sucesso de seus projetos.


Benefícios

  • Bônus por desempenho individual e corporativo.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para colaboradores e familiares.
  • Reembolso de atividades esportivas.
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atividades sociais e de integração.


++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


G Mining Services is a multidisciplinary company that provides professional services to the mining sector, working on both open-pit and underground projects involving precious, base, and industrial metals. Recognized as one of Canada’s leading mining engineering consultancies and among the most respected in international projects, G Mining is expanding and strengthening its presence in Brazil.

Following the success of the Tocantinzinho Mine project, the company is opening a new office in the country to collaborate with local talent on future projects in Brazil and abroad.

As a family-owned company, G Mining values its employees by promoting both professional and personal development through unique career opportunities, collaboration, and a welcoming, safe, and inclusive work environment.


Human Resources Analyst


Position Summary

The professional will serve as a Human Resources Analyst , supporting local operations and contributing to the consolidation of the company’s organizational structure in Brazil. They will be responsible for ensuring the efficient execution of HR routines and for strengthening the corporate culture, fostering a collaborative, ethical, and value-driven work environment aligned with G Mining Services’ global standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the entire recruitment and selection cycle, from job posting to onboarding.
  • Maintain and update employee records and contracts (CLT and service providers).
  • Assist with payroll, time tracking, vacation, benefits, and termination processes.
  • Administer corporate benefits (health, dental, meal, transportation, and life insurance), including monthly controls, enrollments, and removals.
  • Support labor relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT).
  • Organize and execute integration, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas and assist in implementing wellness and culture programs that enhance the employee experience.
  • Prepare HR reports and metrics (headcount, benefits, personnel costs, etc.) to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with global HR and Administration teams, maintaining effective communication in English.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in generalist HR routines.
  • Solid knowledge of labor legislation (CLT) and HR administrative practices.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level for frequent communication with international teams.
  • Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office tools.

Desired Profile

  • Organization and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, integrity, and genuine interest in people.
  • Flexibility and hands-on mindset.


Additional Information

The position will be based at G Mining Services’ office in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The company seeks dynamic and motivated professionals who wish to join an experienced team committed to project success.


Benefits

  • Individual and corporate performance bonuses.
  • Health and dental plans for employees and their families.
  • Reimbursement for sports activities.
  • Training and professional development programs.
  • Social and integration activities.

  • Construção de copys e pequenos textos.

  • Colaborar na construção de identidade visual de marca e projetos.

  • Organização de pastas, arquivos e materiais criativos.



Requisitos


Técnicos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Edição de vídeo em nível avançado (Premiere, CapCut e/ou outros)
  • Ferramentas de design: básico/intermediário.
  • Boa escrita.

Habilidades:

  • Criatividade.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Olhar detalhista e senso estético apurado.
  • Vontade de aprender e evoluir constantemente.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Experiência prévia com e-commerce, moda ou marketing.
  • Boa desenvoltura diante das câmeras e facilidade para criar conteúdos em vídeo.
  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento.
  • Entendimento do segmento de moda streetwear.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de animação (Ex: After Effects).
  • Noções básicas do segmento têxtil.




Por que se candidatar?


  • Ambiente criativo, leve e colaborativo.
  • Contato direto com o fundador e participação ativa nas decisões criativas.
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atuação em projetos relevantes para a marca e para o cenário da moda nacional.
  • Oportunidade de aprendizado em segmentos que vão além da moda.


Como se candidatar?

Envie seu currículo e portfólio até o prazo indicado.

title: Android Developer | Specialist
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar como referência técnica transversal em Android, com foco em Kotlin, apoiando múltiplos squads na concepção e implementação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e acessíveis;
  • Identificar proativamente gaps técnicos, riscos de qualidade ou oportunidades de inovação, propondo, priorizando e liderando iniciativas de melhoria com autonomia;
  • Revisar, alinhar e evoluir arquiteturas mobile, promovendo consistência técnica e boas práticas de acessibilidade desde o código (ex.: content descriptions, hierarquia de foco, suporte a leitores de tela);
  • Liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração e modernização, com ênfase em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM), Jetpack Compose e padrões como MVI, do desenho à entrega e adoção;
  • Estruturar e evoluir a estratégia de testes mobile, definindo níveis apropriados (unitários, integração, instrumentados, E2E), escolhendo tecnologias (JUnit, Espresso, Compose Testing, etc.) e garantindo cobertura eficaz e manutenível;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de clean code, engenharia de qualidade e acessibilidade como parte do ciclo de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar na definição, padronização e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD para mobile (Bitrise, GitHub Actions, etc.), integrando testes automatizados e validações de acessibilidade;
  • Avaliar, validar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias que tragam vantagem competitiva, inovação e melhoria na experiência do usuário, incluindo soluções que ampliem inclusão digital;
  • Atuar como multiplicador(a) de conhecimento, mentorando desenvolvedores em temas como testabilidade, acessibilidade e arquitetura sustentável;
  • Monitorar métricas de performance, estabilidade, cobertura de testes e conformidade com diretrizes de acessibilidade.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Android com Kotlin;
  • Conhecimento prático em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM);
  • Domínio de Jetpack Compose e arquiteturas modernas como MVI;
  • Vivência com engenharia de software de alto nível: Clean Architecture, SOLID, modularização e testabilidade como princípio de design;
  • Experiência em estruturação de estratégias de teste, desde a definição da pirâmide até a escolha e implementação de frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, Compose Testing, etc.);
  • Conhecimento técnico em acessibilidade no Android: capacidade de estruturar layouts e componentes acessíveis, validar com ferramentas e integrar checks no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD para mobile (ex.: Bitrise, GitHub Actions, Jenkins);
  • Habilidade comprovada em revisão de código, definição de padrões técnicos e governança de stack;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de performance (ex.: Firebase Performance Monitor).






Não possui todos os requisitos para a vaga?


Está tudo bem! Na Compass UOL, estimulamos o desenvolvimento contínuo de novos talentos e transformamos desafios em oportunidades.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Lead Software Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | About You

As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for driving the technical vision behind scalable, modern applications while guiding a high‑performing engineering team. You’re someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, hands‑on development, and mentorship, balancing strategic decision‑making with a passion for building exceptional software. You enjoy shaping engineering standards, elevating team capabilities, and making thoughtful choices that influence long-term product success. You’re motivated by solving complex technical challenges and creating environments where engineers can do their best work.


Lead Software Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable applications using .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Define engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines for the development team.
  • Architect and maintain secure, high‑availability cloud-based systems optimized for performance.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business goals.
  • Mentor engineers, fostering continuous learning, quality craftsmanship, and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to quality, security, and maintainability standards.
  • Solve advanced technical challenges and influence decisions related to architecture and technology stack selection.


Lead Software Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with advanced proficiency in .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React).
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and collaborating effectively across functions.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern web development standards.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing applications on AWS or other major cloud platforms.
  • Deep understanding of system architecture, design patterns, and scalable application principles.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

title: PMO Analyst – Telecommunications
description:

ZTE Brazil is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive PMO Analyst to support project governance, performance monitoring, and process standardization across telecom deployment and operations projects. This role will interface with clients such as TIM, Claro, and Vivo, ensuring compliance with internal methodologies and contractual obligations.

  • Support the structuring and maintenance of the project portfolio aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
  • Monitor execution of project schedules, scope, cost, and risk, especially for network deployment projects (RAN, IP, DWDM, Microwave, etc).

  • Previous experience working in multicultural environments or with Chinese organizations is a plus.
  • Advanced English is mandatory; Mandarin or Spanish is a differential.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, Power BI, Jira/Confluence.

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.

  • Familiarity with Anatel regulations and telecom compliance frameworks.

  • MBA or equivalent degree in Project Management.

title: Analista BackOffice Júnior - Renda Fixa
description:
Sobre Nós:

Com mais de duas décadas de história, a Terra Investimentos conquistou a liderança no mercado agro e expandiu sua atuação no mercado financeiro e de capitais, sendo uma corretora full broker em plena expansão voltada para pessoas físicas e clientes institucionais. A Terra Investimentos pertence ao Grupo Ibrahim, sólido conglomerado de empresas com mais de 60 anos de existência e atuação diversificada, destacadamente nos mercados imobiliário, financeiro, industrial e de agronegócios!


Perfil desejado:

Buscamos um perfil organizado, responsável e com interesse no mercado financeiro, que tenha facilidade para lidar com pressão e goste de atuar de forma executora no dia a dia de BackOffice.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Registro, liquidação e conciliação de títulos de renda fixa públicos e privados (mercado primário e secundário);

O que esperamos de você:

  • PQO BackOffice;

Qual será seu local de trabalho?

Local: Itaim Bibi, São Paulo/SP

Horário comercial

️ Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação flexíveis (R$ 1.812,00/mês);

title: Designer gráfico
description:
Sobre a vaga - Enviar Portfólio


Você será responsável por criar peças visuais impactantes, que traduzam conceitos estratégicos em conteúdo visual de alta qualidade.


Você terá autonomia e liberdade, não fugindo da ideia principal que é gerar profissionalismo e segurança.


Vai atuar com uma equipe de copywriter, social media, tráfego pago, videomaker e branding, entregando criatividade com foco em resultado real.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Criar layouts para posts, carrosséis, anúncios, reels, stories, landing pages, e-mails marketing, apresentações e materiais gráficos impressos.


  • Adaptar conceitos visuais para campanhas online e offline, mantendo coerência da identidade visual das marcas.


  • Apoiar o time de tráfego pago, entregando criativos A/B para testes de performance.


  • Colaborar com copywriter para garantir harmonia entre texto e design, com leitura fluida, escaneabilidade e conversão.


  • Manter atualizado o banco de ativos visuais, pastas de arquivos e assets organizados.


  • Apoiar o Diretor de Criação no desenvolvimento de guias de identidade visual, templates e diretrizes de marca.


  • Acompanhar tendências de design, motion e comportamento do consumidor para propor peças inovadoras.


Experiência


  • Experiência como Designer Gráfico, preferencialmente em agências de marketing, publicidade ou design digital, o essencial é dominar o que você faz.


  • Portfólio com peças variadas, incluindo redes sociais, campanhas de performance, branding e materiais impressos.


Habilidades técnicas


  • Domínio de ferramentas de design: Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).


  • Conhecimento de design para web (Figma, XD ou Webflow básico) para criação de layouts de landing pages ou sites.


  • Boa compreensão de diagramação, tipografia, paleta de cores, hierarquia visual e escaneabilidade.


  • Atenção a detalhes técnicos para materiais impressos e artes finais.


Competências comportamentais


  • Perfil criativo, organizado e comprometido com prazos.


  • Proatividade para sugerir novas abordagens visuais.


  • Facilidade para receber e aplicar feedbacks construtivos.


  • Boa comunicação para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em branding, desenvolvimento de identidade visual e guias de marca.


  • Conhecimento em UX/UI básico para criar peças com foco em conversão.


  • Cases de criativos que performaram bem em campanhas de mídia paga.


  • Saber fazer um bom trabalho, independente de formação acadêmica.


Regime de contratação


CLT, com registro em carteira.


Trabalho 100% presencial.


Horário comercial, segunda a sexta.


Faixa salarial inicial R$ 2.500

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Consultor de Sistemas (Interface TI X Negócio)

Esta vaga de Consultor(a) de Sistemas atua de forma semelhante a um Product Owner , sendo o elo entre Negócios e TI para priorização de demandas, definição de requisitos e evolução dos sistemas de seguros.

  • Organização de documentos e processos ; noções de governança e segurança da informação .
  • Perfil analítico , atenção a detalhes e boa comunicação .

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

About Ocean Network Express (ONE)

Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK). The new entity functions from its global headquarters in Singapore, supported by regional headquarters in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Brazil. title: Especialista de Inovação em Engenharia
description:
Somos movidos por resultados e vivemos um momento de crescimento acelerado, com grandes lançamentos previstos e metas ainda mais ambiciosas para os próximos anos.


Se você busca desafios e quer liderar a transformação em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, essa oportunidade é para você !


Como Especialista de Inovação em Engenharia você irá se reportar à Gerência de Orçamentos e Custos de Engenharia .

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

A área será criada dentro da Engenharia, com perspectiva de integração futura com outras áreas da companhia. A posição terá papel estratégico na estruturação da célula de Engenharia que apoiará o novo braço de negócios focado em loteamentos, aprofundando o conhecimento técnico desse tipo de empreendimento, apoiando tecnicamente a execução das obras e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de processos, padrões e boas práticas que consolidem essa nova frente dentro da empresa.



O que você fará por aqui:


  • Levantar novas tecnologias, materiais, métodos executivos e sistemas construtivos;
  • Estruturar comparativos completos (técnicos, econômicos, operacionais);
  • Elaborar recomendações com base em dados, boas práticas e referências de mercado;
  • Conduzir estudos de ponta a ponta: definição de escopo, coleta e consolidação de dados, análises, modelagem de custos totais e recomendações executivas;
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e executivos com clareza, precisão e visão sistêmica;
  • Realizar visitas a obras referência, fornecedores e parceiros para observação de métodos, testes, práticas e oportunidades aplicáveis ao contexto da empresa;
  • Registrar aprendizados e transformar em insumos reais para estudos técnicos;
  • Implementar testes em parceria com obras, fornecedores e áreas internas;
  • Monitorar indicadores, desempenho e viabilidade de escala;
  • Mapear tendências do setor, acompanhar evolução de tecnologias e atualizar repositórios internos;
  • Atuar como ponto focal na organização das informações técnicas de inovação;
  • Interação principal com Projetos, Obras, Qualidade, Suprimentos, Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Construir alinhamento técnico, validar premissas e apresentar conclusões.



Requisitos e qualificações:

O que esperamos que você tenha:


  • Formação em Engenharia Civil;
  • Experiência prévia em obras, planejamento, suprimentos ou tecnologia construtiva;
  • Rigor analítico, boa estrutura lógica e domínio de modelagem técnico-econômica.
  • Capacidade de investigação técnica e comparação de alternativas;
  • Comunicação clara para traduzir estudos complexos em propostas objetivas;
  • Interesse genuíno por inovação e evolução técnica;
  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade de aprofundar análises;
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de múltiplos temas;
  • Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade e consistência nas entregas;
  • Capacidade de se relacionar bem com diferentes perfis técnicos;
  • Curiosidade, abertura ao novo e disposição para explorar alternativas.



Informações adicionais:

Benefícios que refletem o nosso jeito de cuidar


Na Plano&Plano, acreditamos que cada conquista é construída junto.


Por isso, nossos benefícios foram pensados para apoiar você em todas as fases da jornada, no trabalho, em casa e na vida.


Essenciais para o dia a dia:


  • Vale-refeição no cartão Flash: liberdade total para escolher onde e como usar;
  • Vale-transporte ou fretado: com desconto de até 6%, garantindo mais mobilidade e praticidade;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): porque o sucesso é coletivo e celebramos juntos cada conquista!.


Saúde e bem-estar em primeiro lugar:


  • Assistência Médica Bradesco Saúde: cobertura nacional para cuidar de você;
  • Assistência odontológica Bradesco (opcional): um sorriso saudável também faz parte da nossa rotina;
  • Seguro de Vida MetLife: tranquilidade e proteção para você;
  • Wellhub (Gympass): equilíbrio entre corpo e mente com acesso a academias, terapias e programas de bem-estar;
  • Cartão Natalidade: para celebrar esse momento tão especial com mais tranquilidade.


Qualidade de vida que inspira


  • Day Off de Aniversário: um dia de folga para você celebrar do seu jeito;
  • Emendas de feriados e recesso de fim de ano: tempo extra para descansar e recarregar as energias, sem desconto das férias.


Vantagens que vão além


  • Desconto especial na compra do seu apartamento Plano&Plano: o sonho da casa própria pode começar aqui!;


Outras informações


  • Local: escritório próximo ao metrô Butantã, em São Paulo;
  • Jornada: segunda a sexta-feira, presencial, porque acreditamos que conexões reais constroem grandes resultados.

  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when necessary.

  • Ability to accurately describe issues, collect applicable documentation, and operate as a liaison between the product team and the customer
  • Prior experience documenting new features and getting your requests prioritized into Sprints

  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, technical engineering, or Information Technology

  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management

description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HR Plant Manager to lead strategic HR initiatives and ensure operational excellence across our plants in Taubaté (SP) and Goiana (PE).

This is a key leadership role, partnering closely with the Plant Manager and HR Director to drive organizational effectiveness, foster a high-performance culture, and deliver impactful HR solutions.

description:
Geólogo(a) de Exploração Pleno


Local: Riacho dos Machados, MG

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região


Sobre a Oportunidade

Responder pela execução de trabalhos de natureza geológica, sondagens, amostragens, mapeamento, modelamento, estimativa e interpretações geológicas, englobando a conceituação inicial, desenvolvimento até a realização do projeto, mapeamento geológico e amostragem (subsolo e superfície), contribuindo para avaliação do potencial aurífero das áreas, para as operações de extração e que resultem na expansão da reserva mineral e manutenção dos alvarás de pesquisa e lavra concedidos..


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar atividades de mapeamento e amostragens relacionadas a programas de pesquisa mineral e liderar tecnicamente as equipes das diversas frentes de trabalho da área de Geologia, buscando a otimização e produtividade durante a execução dos procedimentos de rotina e a boa interação com as demais áreas da empresa;

  • Descrição dos Log´s de sondagem: litologias, estruturas, alteração hidrotermal e mineralizações, a fim de garantir a qualidade da informação que será utilizada nos processos subsequentes da cadeia de exploração mineral;

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Atuar no planejamento regulatório com foco na gestão do contrato, realizando análises econômico-financeiras, acompanhamento de indicadores contratuais e avaliação de impactos regulatórios no fluxo de caixa e na receita da companhia.

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em planejamento financeiro, concessões, PPPs ou contratos de longo prazo.
  • Domínio de modelagem econômico-financeira, fluxo de caixa e DRE.
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados será um diferencial.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 19.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Kubernetes engineering, platform engineering, or cloud-native infrastructure roles.
  • Hands-on experience with some Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, AKS, EKS, GKE, VMware Tanzu , or upstream).
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
  • Experience with OpenLens and other K8s management tools
  • Strong understanding of container orchestration, container runtimes, registries , and image security.
  • Expertise with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, FluxCD/ArgoCD, Helm ).
  • Experience with Linux system administration and OS-level troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of networking concepts (CNI, load balancers, service mesh, DNS, ingress/egress).
  • Experience with CSI persistent storage solutions and cluster storage migrations.
  • Knowledge of DevOps tooling: CI/CD, GitOps, monitoring/observability, vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust and cybersecurity controls in production environments.
  • Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).
  • Experience with GKE and enterprise virtualization platforms.
  • Experience designing Kubernetes platforms for AI/GPU workloads.

title: Branding Designer/Experience
description:
Por favor envie portfólio.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Designer de Branding/Experience para atuar de forma estratégica em nossos projetos criativos. Este profissional será responsável pela criação de identidades visuais alinhadas com os objetivos da marca, desenvolvimento de interfaces interativas e design centrado no usuário. As atividades diárias incluirão brainstorming, apresentações de ideias, prototipagem e colaboração com equipes de marketing e desenvolvimento. Este é um cargo de meio período e realizado no formato remoto.



Atribuições da vaga – Designer de Branding
  • Desenvolver e evoluir identidades visuais de marcas atendidas pela Grow360, garantindo coerência, consistência e alinhamento estratégico com posicionamento e propósito.
  • Criar conceitos visuais que traduzam estratégia em design, fortalecendo branding, percepção de valor e autoridade das marcas.
  • Desdobrar identidades visuais para diferentes pontos de contato: redes sociais, apresentações institucionais, materiais comerciais, campanhas, sites e peças digitais .
  • Atuar em conjunto com os times de estratégia, marketing e comercial , interpretando briefings estratégicos e transformando-os em soluções visuais eficazes.
  • Garantir padronização visual e qualidade estética em todas as entregas, respeitando guias de marca e boas práticas de design.
  • Participar da criação e manutenção de brandbooks, guias visuais e sistemas de identidade .
  • Contribuir com ideias criativas e estratégicas para fortalecimento da marca Grow360 e das marcas dos clientes.
  • Acompanhar tendências de design, branding e comunicação, aplicando referências relevantes aos projetos.
  • Revisar, ajustar e otimizar peças visuais com base em feedbacks estratégicos e objetivos de negócio.



Qualificações – Designer de BrandingRequisitos:
  • Formação completa ou em andamento em Design Gráfico, Design Visual, Comunicação, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas .
  • Experiência comprovada com branding e identidade visual , incluindo criação e desdobramento de marcas.
  • Portfólio que demonstre pensamento estratégico aplicado ao design , não apenas peças isoladas.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign e/ou Figma .
  • Capacidade de interpretar briefings estratégicos e transformar posicionamento, propósito e diferenciais em soluções visuais.
  • Forte senso estético, atenção a detalhes e preocupação com consistência visual.
  • Boa comunicação para apresentar, justificar decisões criativas e receber feedbacks.
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência com brandbooks, guias de identidade e sistemas de marca .
  • Vivência em consultorias, agências ou estúdios de branding .
  • Conhecimento em design aplicado a marketing digital, social media e campanhas .
  • Noções de posicionamento de marca, arquétipos, tom de voz e storytelling visual .
  • Experiência com apresentações institucionais, materiais comerciais e propostas estratégicas .
  • Conhecimento básico de motion design ou direção de arte.
﻿Competências comportamentais:
  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultado, não apenas estética.
  • Organização e boa gestão de prazos e múltiplos projetos.
  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e olhar crítico sobre o próprio trabalho.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Interesse genuíno por marcas, negócios e crescimento empresarial .
  • Alinhamento com a cultura da Grow360: crescimento, consistência, execução e impacto real .

title: Customer Experience (CX) Supervisor
description:
People Human Resources is leading the recruitment process for a fast-growing international company operating in the health and wellness services and technology sector, with a global footprint and a direct impact on the lives of thousands of people.

This is a strategic opportunity based in São Paulo, leading a Customer Experience team that provides support to users in the United Kingdom, working in close partnership with global teams located in Brazil and the UK.

The professional will be responsible for building, leading, and developing a high-performing team, ensuring a consistent, empathetic, and efficient customer/patient experience throughout the entire journey.

We are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, has a strong sense of ownership, an analytical mindset, and a genuine passion for developing people and delivering exceptional customer experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of Customer Experience Specialists, setting clear expectations and monitoring performance
  • Coach and develop the team, fostering growth, autonomy, and excellence in customer support
  • Build a strong team culture based on accountability, quality, and high service standards
  • Analyze data, feedback, and customer interactions to identify opportunities for process improvement
  • Collaborate closely with global and cross-functional teams (Product, Operations, Clinical teams, among others)
  • Set goals, track KPIs, and drive continuous operational improvement
  • Support team growth and structuring, ensuring efficiency and scalability

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in English, with daily use in a business environment
  • Previous experience leading or supporting teams in startup and fast-paced environments (experience in healthcare is a plus)
  • Strong interest in people development and building high-performing teams
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple demands
  • Comfort using data to support decision-making and performance tracking
  • Proactive profile, hands-on attitude, and strong problem-solving skills
  • Genuine interest in joining a growing project with real impact on the customer experience


Work Model

  • Hybrid role based in São Paulo (on-site 2 to 3 days per week)
  • Constant interaction with international teams


If you are energized by fast-growing environments, enjoy leading teams, and are driven to transform the patient experience through innovation and empathy, this could be your next opportunity. We look forward to your application!

title: Consultor Técnico Pl P&D - Industrial
description:
O FI Group busca um profissional de TI para atuar como Consultor (a) Técnico Pl em Belo Horizonte!


O Consultor (a) Técnico Pl irá controlar e acompanhar carteira de clientes, realizando contatos telefônicos, por e-mail e visitas presenciais, analisando a elegibilidade dos projetos, avaliando as características técnicas, riscos, avanços tecnológicos em função de diretrizes, conforme manuais e procedimentos, a fim de classificar os projetos quanto a viabilidade do incentivo fiscal.


Como Consultor (a) Técnico Pl, você irá:

  • Responsável por contribuir para o bom funcionamento e o objetivo do SGSI - Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação da ISO 27001 e seguir as diretrizes de segurança das informações definidas pela direção e comitê. Responsável por contribuir para o atendimento aos requisitos e objetivos do SGQ - Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade da ISO 9001 e seguir as diretrizes definidas pela Direção;
  • Estudar a legislação, casos, serviços e produtos prestados pelo FI Group, através de leitura de guias internos, para obter conhecimento técnico e operacional, dentro dos procedimentos de consultoria, para condução da gestão de empresas categorizadas no mínimo com score C;
  • Efetuar alinhamento para mapear informações técnicas e os dispêndios envolvidos nos projetos, avaliando a tipologia e enquadramento, de acordo com o incentivo fiscal ou programa de fomento trabalhado, a fim de atribuir valor as atividades identificadas e calcular o benefício fiscal ou pleitear recursos para o cliente. De modo a garantir a rastreabilidade necessária perante os incentivos;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com foco nas áreas de conhecimento dos projetos, visando defender o conteúdo inovador e o enquadramento das atividades de PD&I na candidatura dos incentivos fiscais ou recursos para inovação Manter as ferramentas de gestão interna atualizadas, em tempo real, com informações referentes ao mapeamento da carteira de clientes, andamento dos produtos trabalhados e demais indicadores operacionais Seguir com analise critica da carteira;
  • Confeccionar e revisar dossiês econômicos, técnicos e finais para sua carteira de clientes, contendo balancetes e seus respectivos comprovativos econômicos, rastreabilidade contábil, relatórios, formulários e demais informações solicitadas pelos órgãos competentes. Assim como prestar suporte operacional e técnico aos outros consultores em todas as etapas do trabalho;
  • Realizar a apresentações junto aos clientes, com finalidades diversificadas, tais como início dos trabalhos, acompanhamento e finalização;
  • Participar de workshop e treinamentos internos para disseminação de conhecimentos e metodologias referentes aos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação, e externos para aculturamento a fim de identificar novas oportunidades dos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação. Realizar ações de relacionamento, visando fidelização da parceria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação completa em: Química, Química Tecnológica, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Metalúrgica ou Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Habilidades avançadas em Excel;
  • Conhecimento dos mecanismos de fomento, especialmente Lei do Bem;
  • CNH ativa (Condução via carro manual);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas aos clientes.



Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Cursos e especializações na área de conhecimento;
  • Experiência em indústrias farmacêuticas e alimentícias;
  • Habilidade em comunicação e escrita (elaboração de relatórios).


O que oferecemos no FI Group:

  • Salário competitivo;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;

description:

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora (Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Dev-Admin Tools para:

  • Desenvolvimento de novas features e correções de bugs, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participação do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de projetos de Software;
  • Auxílio ativo no refinamento de necessidades técnicas;
  • Participação dos ritos em um modelo de desenvolvimento ágil;
  • Execução de testes de desenvolvimento e auxílio ao time de QA para validação das entregas;

  • Apoio ao cliente em dúvidas relacionadas com a integração com os nossos produtos.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com planejamento, e estimava de desenvolvimento de Software;
  • Experiência com Java 11 e 17+, SpringBoot, APIs REST, Arquitetura de microsserviços, CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Orchestrador;
